physical_policy.principle: Physical qualification is a fixed scenario checklist, not an open-ended subjective review.
blocking_scenarios: selection chrome logical size and DPR crispness at 50/100/200/400%
mouse/touch/pen handle acquisition using frozen visual/hit geometry
move/resize/rotate/cancel with no visible commit jump or stale chrome
slow/fast pan, wheel/pinch zoom, zoomAt anchor, 50/100/200 presets, fit document/selection
snap engage/release hysteresis and guide continuity under deterministic traces
G4.5 Pen + Laser coexistence with editing overlay

forbidden_authority_expansion: No lowering of A/B automated obligations based on physical feel.
frozen_statements: C composes accepted SelectionSession, TransformSession/TransientSceneOverride, FrameState/RenderViewRuntime, RuntimeFacade and existing G4.5 brush/Laser owners.
Platform adapters may expose and call existing common owners for qualification; they may not invent a second scene, selection, transform, camera, brush, Arc or history semantics.
InputRouter, BrushEngine, canonical schema/operation/mutation semantics, Undo/Redo and Arc ownership remain unchanged.
Required Windows/Web/Android physical observations remain blocking for C terminal success; automated or hosted evidence cannot substitute for them.
Frame timing is measured, not part of deterministic digest equality; missing observations must be explicit and cannot be fabricated.
The v0.2 repair addresses exact package/proof identity and acceptance mappings only; it does not expand Authority or waive original C requirements.
